The '''spaceport tower''' of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] was a [[Mooring tower/Legends|tower]] erected in the [[Temple district/Legends|Temple district]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

==History==
Located in the [[Temple district/Legends|Temple district]], the mooring tower of the Jedi Temple was established by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to accommodate larger [[Starship/Legends|starships]] landing at the Temple.<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jai Maruk]] landed a [[Seltaya-class fast courier|''Seltaya''-class courier]] at the tower having returned gravely injured from an encounter with [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. At the time, Chief Technician [[Boz Addle]] oversaw all flights in and out of the Precinct, reporting to [[Temple Security Force]]s if anyone landed without Temple's approval.<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
